turns.question: What were our sales on 1 October 2026?
turns.answer: "Sales" can mean revenue (gross) or net revenue (after returns), so here are both for 1 October 2026 (a single day): revenue was EUR 981.69 and net revenue was EUR 964.19. Fresh: returns.silver is ready up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z. Late: sales.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.

turns.answer: Net revenue (after partner returns) on 1 October 2026 (a single day) was EUR 964.19. Fresh: returns.silver is ready up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z. Late: sales.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
